name: Facet Horizon
promptTemplate: A low-poly landscape bathed in {{palette}} light with {{mountain_height}} elevation scale, {{drift_speed}} facet drift, {{roughness}} ridge roughness, {{wireframe}} facet outlines, and a {{light_orbit}} sun

palette.hint: Cycle sky gradients and facet tint schemes

wireframe.hint: Toggle triangle boundary edges and glow intensity

mountain_height.hint: Scale vertical relief across the mountain peaks

drift_speed.hint: Rate at which vertex points oscillate and ripple

roughness.hint: Sharpen jagged noise along the ridges

light_orbit.hint: Trajectory of the primary directional sun

listing.blurb: A low-poly landscape: a Delaunay triangulation of scattered points, each triangle shaded from a sky-to-ground gradient and lit by a moving light, the points drifting so the facets shimmer.
listing.prompt: A low-poly landscape: a Delaunay triangulation of scattered points, each triangle shaded from a sky-to-ground gradient and lit by a moving light, the points drifting so the facets shimmer. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
